coordinates.conversion: Blender (x,y,z) -> glTF (x,z,-y). GLB already converted; no extra browser rotation.
coordinates.rest_rotations: All rig pivot local rest quaternions are identity. Geometry is parent-local, not world-baked twice.

body_motion_limits.status: Yaw is independent of leg reach. Circular body/carrier bearing supports arbitrary relative yaw. Body and carrier are siblings; never constrain BODY_CTRL yaw by foot reach.

legs.notes: HIP->KNEE is upper armor; KNEE->ANKLE is shank; ANKLE->FOOT is needle. Foot node holds contact hardware. Identity local rest rotations. Two-bone solver may treat KNEE->FOOT as a rigid lower assembly with ankle neutral.

limits: PBR materials are approximate; source procedural bumps and Cycles illumination are not baked.
No browser physics is encoded in the GLB.
Dynamic curve endpoint anchors retain the source positions, which may not coincide with physical sockets.
All four legs have rigid articulated segments; cut surfaces need movement-range visual verification.

No collision-aware cable simulation is baked. Rerouted shell cables belong to BODY_CTRL; leg conduits remain segmented with their actual legs. Circular bearing clearance is evaluated separately from the leg solver.

leg_carrier_motion_limits.status: Runtime step-following carrier; enforce actual leg joint/reach bounds on LEG_CARRIER and feet only.

bearing.note: Recessed sleeve and spindle; body shell is yaw-independent from the four leg chains. Runtime cable collision is not modeled.
